# Site packages: start here

When Exponential is installed, the new site is not built from code alone. It is built from **site installer
packages**: archives (`.ezpkg`) that carry content classes, content, settings, roles and install scripts, and that
the setup wizard, the kickstarter and `exp:install` read from a **package server**. This section explains all of it,
from the file format to publishing a package of your own.

It is written for administrators who install sites, developers who build or change site packages, hosting companies
who choose what a new customer site contains, and designers who ship a site style or a whole starter site. Every
setting, file and URL on these pages was checked against the code, the packages and the live package server.

> **Tip**
> Built a site package? 7x and the Exponential Foundation strongly encourage you to submit it by pull request to the
> repository behind the package server, so every installation can offer it:
> [Contribute your site package](contribute-your-site-package.md).

## The short version

- A **package** is a folder with a `package.xml` and the files it names, shipped as one gzip compressed tar file
  ending in `.ezpkg`. A **site package** is a package of type `site`; it requires other packages (content classes,
  content) and can carry install scripts that set up siteaccesses, extensions, roles and preferences.
- The **package server** is a static HTTPS site,
  [exponential.packages.exponential.earth](https://exponential.packages.exponential.earth/), published by GitHub
  Pages from [se7enxweb/exponential.packages.exponential.earth](https://github.com/se7enxweb/exponential.packages.exponential.earth).
  It has one folder per Exponential release with an `index.xml` and the `.ezpkg` files.
- An installation finds the server through `settings/package.ini [RepositorySettings] RemotePackagesIndexURL`
  (for 6.0.15: `https://exponential.packages.exponential.earth/exponential/6.0/6.0.15`). Downloaded packages are
  kept in `var/storage/packages/<vendor>/`, vendor `7x`.
- The 6.0.15 index offers twelve site packages. The default is **sevenx_multisite** (7x MultiSite); **cjw_multisite**
  is the CJW starter site with an English and a German site.
- The sources of the packages are in their own GitHub repositories
  ([se7enxweb/sevenx-ezpackage](https://github.com/se7enxweb/sevenx-ezpackage),
  [se7enxweb/cjw_multisite-ezpackage](https://github.com/se7enxweb/cjw_multisite-ezpackage) and others); a build
  script turns each folder into an `.ezpkg`.
- You can make your own versions, publish them on a server of your own and point your installations at it in INI
  settings or in ezupdate's package servers; or, better for everyone, contribute them to the shared server.
